description:
Crono is the Sales Execution Layer for B2B revenue teams and AI agents. Its MCP server connects AI assistants to your sales workspace, bringing prospect data, CRM history, buying signals and sales activity into the context of every task.

With read and write access, your assistant can help you:

• Find and enrich prospects and contacts.
• Review deals, identify stalled opportunities and prioritize follow-ups.
• Manage multichannel sequences.
• Use buying signals to identify relevant outreach opportunities.
• Access sales analytics to understand team performance.

Ask questions about your pipeline or take action using natural language. For example: “Review deals closing this month, flag those with no recent activity and draft re-engagement messages.”

Works with MCP-compatible clients and custom AI agents, so your team can work with Crono directly from the tools they already use.
